title: MessageBird SMS Message
description: Represents an SMS message sent or received through the MessageBird SMS Messaging API.

id.description: A unique random identifier for the message, generated by the MessageBird platform.

href.description: The URL of the message resource.

direction.description: The direction of the message. mt for outbound, mo for inbound.

originator.description: The sender of the message. Can be a phone number or alphanumeric string.

body.description: The body of the SMS message.

reference.description: A client reference for tracking purposes.

reportUrl.description: The URL for delivery report callbacks.

validity.description: The validity period of the message in seconds.

gateway.description: The SMS route used to send the message.

datacoding.description: The encoding used for the message body.

scheduledDatetime.description: The scheduled date and time for the message in RFC 3339 format.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the message was created.

Recipients.description: The recipients collection for the message.

totalDeliveryFailedCount.description: The number of messages that failed to deliver.

Recipient.description: A single message recipient with delivery status.

status.description: The delivery status of the message for this recipient.

statusDatetime.description: The date and time of the last status update.
